context: New official disclosures establish broader institutional distribution and tokenized-asset activity across Coinbase, Circle, Ripple, SBI, Standard Chartered and Aviva. The objective is to separate real product access and custody from actual XRP capital and price effects.
decisions: Admit Coinbase's RLUSD listing on XRPL, Base and Ethereum to the institutional event timeline; do not treat it as XRP buying.
Record Coinbase Global Exchange RLUSD collateral support as planned at launch, not live.
Record Coinbase Q3 USDC economics and trading share as company-reported platform context, not XRP-specific metrics.
Record Ripple National Trust Bank charter as OCC-approved and effective on October 26, 2026, with trust powers requested; do not infer general commercial banking powers or XRP reserves.
Record Aviva's GBP 50M as investment in a tokenized fund share class on XRPL, not XRP purchases; keep the GBP 22B conventional fund AUM off-chain.
Record Standard Chartered RLUSD custody as live for eligible clients through its DIFC branch; record LMAX collateral mirroring as planned and conditional.
Record SBI recurring accumulation, Visa rewards and Orico points as XRP distribution channels; actual XRP units, sourcing and net market purchases remain unknown.
Retain SBI's Circle/USDC and Ripple/RLUSD/XRP relationships as simultaneous multi-rail strategy; do not infer exclusivity or forced winner.
Admit institutional events to the timeline and relationship graph only; do not admit directional price features without measured usage, flows, fee impact or actual XRP execution evidence.
required_verification: Obtain Coinbase RLUSD deposits, withdrawals, balances and trading volumes by supported network when publicly available.
Verify the first live Coinbase Global Exchange RLUSD collateral schedule and balances before changing status from planned.
Obtain Ripple National Trust Bank approved powers, operating launch and public product disclosures.
Track Aviva XRPL token issuance, redemptions, eligible holders, secondary transfers, network fees and repeat subscriptions.
Verify Standard Chartered/LMAX collateral launch and actual collateral balances.
Obtain SBI aggregate XRP accumulation purchases, reward credits, Orico redemptions and inventory/venue sourcing.
Cross-check Circle and SBI USDC activity against XRPL and Arc chain data without assuming all SBI activity is on one network.
actual_capital_policy: A fund-share investment, stablecoin balance, reward credit, issuer mint, customer custody balance, OTC transfer and spot execution are different capital categories. Only actual XRP spot/OTC execution or a reconciled net XRP acquisition is admitted as XRP purchase capital.
